title: vb.run_record/1
description: One arm's run of one task instance, a row of records.jsonl (S08 §5.4): a projection of S01's records, written by the driver for every arm. The top level, `costs` and `usage` are closed; other nested objects may carry extra detail. validate.py also enforces the cost invariants: an unknown cost is null, never 0.

arm.description: an arm id, e.g. cheap_direct, roko_fixed, fd_claude (S08 §4.9)

config_hash.description: S01's BLAKE3 b3: hash of the canonical, secret-redacted effective config

price_snapshot_id.description: the one snapshot every cost in this record uses, e.g. prices-2026-09-28

perturbations_active.description: the S08 §4.6 hooks active at this position

ladder.description: difficulty level ℓ1–ℓ5 (S08 §4.4); null for a row that has no level: a plan-level slice feature (family PL, S09 §4.9)

operator.description: for vague and refined variants: the operator that produced the spec

status.description: infra_error and leak_suspected runs are excluded from results and counted

queue_wait_s.description: S09 §4.9: the seconds ready work spent waiting for a dispatch slot or a provider rate limit, summed over the run's attempts (each attempt's queue_wait_s) and reported beside the makespan, never subtracted from it. null when the arm cannot observe it, as for a runner that does not record it; never 0 for unknown

items.description: S01 roko.attempt_open/1 + roko.verdict/1; direct and CLI arms emit the same shape with emitter vb-driver

model_reported.description: the model the provider says served the attempt; costs are priced by it. null when it did not say

usage.description: Token usage as reported (S01 §5.5), mapped onto disjoint classes by S01 §4.4's table; null when none was reported, which makes the cost unknown. tokens_in counts only uncached input: Anthropic's input_tokens already excludes cache reads and writes, but an OpenAI-style prompt_tokens includes its cached tokens, so there tokens_in = prompt_tokens - cached_tokens. api_equiv_usd is then each class times its snapshot rate. A missing cache-write field means no cache writes were reported.

tokens_reasoning.description: already inside tokens_out when the snapshot row has reasoning_in_output = true

task_id.description: the plan task the attempt worked on (a Roko plan's task id); absent or null for a single-task arm without a plan

cost_class.description: what the attempt's spend was for (S09 §4.9): plan (the planner), execute (a task's first attempt), retry (a later attempt on the model before it), escalate (a later attempt on another model, a rung up the ladder), integrate (merges, conflict repairs and whole-plan gate runs). Absent or null when the runner does not class its attempts; costs.by_class sums it

started_at.description: when the attempt's task started working on it: with finished_at, the attempt's busy time

queue_wait_s.description: the seconds the attempt's work waited for a dispatch slot or a provider rate limit; null when unknown, never 0

flake_injected.description: S08 §4.6 flaky_verify: the visible-verify wrapper failed at least one of the arm's own visible check runs on purpose. passed and clean_rerun are the census's rerun, which no flake reaches

verify_runs.description: how many times the arm ran a visible check through the visible-verify wrapper; null when the run had none (no flaky_verify)

flakes.description: every failure the wrapper injected, by the number of the visible check run it failed

vs.description: The VS-census label (S05 §0): completion, visible checks on a clean re-run, the truth suite, integrity, and the honeypot rule for F8. An unknown label counts as 0.

costs.description: S01 §4.4's single cost-field set, summed over the attempts. api_equiv_usd (tokens x snapshot rates) is what P1 uses. An unknown cost is null, never 0.

billed_usd.description: what the account pays: 0 on a subscription CLI

without_cache_usd.description: the same tokens with cache reads priced as input

vendor_usd.description: the vendor's own figure: a provider-billed charge or the CLI's reported cost

source.description: S01's cost.source; mock usage never becomes a run record

by_class.description: api_equiv_usd split by the attempts' cost_class (S09 §4.9: the planner's share of the cost, and the retries, escalations and integration beside the first attempts). null when the runner does not class its attempts. A class with no attempt is 0; a class with an attempt whose cost is unknown is null, never 0. When every class is known they sum to api_equiv_usd

audit.description: S01 roko.audit/1: the harness's own M4 selection and result (S05). Its digests (record_id, prev_hash, record_hash) are SHA-256, written sha256:, because they belong to S05's ledger chain (S01 §5.7)
